Pronunciation: a:rine [uh-reen]. Noun: Arine is a name of Basque origin meaning "light." Arine illuminates the possibilities with medication management to deliver comprehensive economic and health outcomes.

Based in San Francisco, Arine is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and clinical services company with a mission to ensure individuals receive the safest and most effective treatments for their unique and evolving healthcare needs.

Frequently, medications cause more harm than good. Incorrect drugs and doses costs the US healthcare system over $528 billion in waste, avoidable harm, and hospitalizations each year. Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers.

Why is Arine a Great Place to Work?:

Outstanding Team and Culture - Our shared mission unites and motivates us to do our best work. We have a relentless passion and commitment to the innovation required to be the market leader in medication intelligence.

Making a Proven Difference in Healthcare - We are saving patient lives, and enabling individuals to experience improved health outcomes, including significant reductions in hospitalizations and cost of care.

Market Opportunity - Arine is backed by leading healthcare investors and was founded to tackle one of the largest healthcare problems today. Non-optimized medications therapies which cost the US 275,000 lives and $528 billion annually.

Momentum That Matters - In just over eight years, Arine has grown into one of the fastest-growing healthcare AI companies, serving more than 45 million members through partnerships with leading health plans nationwide. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years, we're combining rapid growth with meaningful impact on the quality, cost, and outcomes of care.

The Role

Arine is revolutionizing healthcare workflows through our AI Outreach initiative. We are building a configurable, Agentic calling framework that uses ambient listening and AI-driven orchestration for patient, pharmacy, and provider interventions. This project aims to elevate clinical workflows, ensure highly personalized patient engagement, and deliver measurable improvements in clinical outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Internship Focus Areas



- SOAP Note Transformation: You will focus on the AI logic required to convert unstructured call summarizations into high-quality, clinical-grade SOAP (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan) notes. This includes leveraging foundation models like Claude 3.5 Sonnet to extract structured clinical facts from live transcripts.
- Prompt Generation & Agent Behavior: You will help build Arine's prompt generation, defining guardrails and determining how the agent should respond to questions or comments from the stakeholder it is talking to. This work ensures complex, human-aware AI engagement that understands patient sentiment and care gaps in real-time.

Who You Are And What You Bring



- Experience with LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT-X) and prompt engineering.
- Familiarity with AWS (Bedrock, Lambda) and Python.
- Experience with Azure (AI Foundry)
- Interest in healthcare technology and clinical documentation workflows.
- Completed Bachelor's degree or Masters Degree. 

Remote Work Requirements



- An established private work area that ensures information privacy
- Reliable internet capable of low latency with the ability to carry video and voice calls without breaking up
- This role is 100% remote.

Perks

Joining Arine offers you a dynamic role and the opportunity to contribute to the company's growth and shape its future. You'll have unparalleled learning and growth prospects, collaborating closely with experienced Clinicians, Engineers, Software Architects, and Digital Health Entrepreneurs.

The posted range represents the expected salary for this position and does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, benefits, and perks. Ultimately, the final pay decision will consider factors such as your experience, job level, location, and other relevant job-related criteria. The pay rate for this position is $25.00 per hour.

Job Requirements



- Ability to pass a background check
- Must live in and be eligible to work in the United States

Information Security Roles And Responsibilities

All staff at Arine are expected to be part of its Information Security Management Program and undergo periodic training on Information Security Awareness and HIPAA guidelines. Each user is responsible to maintain a secure working environment and follow all policies and procedures. Upon hire, each person is assigned and must complete trainings before access is granted for their specific role within Arine.

Check our website at https://www.arine.io. This is a unique opportunity to join a growing start-up revolutionizing the healthcare industry!

Arine is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with fairness and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our hiring decisions and employment practices are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join us in our mission.

For security purposes, official communications from Arine will only come from @arine.io email addresses or through our authorized platforms, including Rippling, TurboCheck, Jobma, and Checkr. If you receive a message claiming to be from Arine through another source, or if you have concerns about its authenticity, please contact us before sharing personal information or taking any action. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information (copy of government-issued ID, social security number, bank details, etc.) during the recruiting process.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: We appreciate your interest in finding talent for Arine, but please be advised that we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. All resumes submitted to Arine without a prior written agreement in place will be considered property of Arine, and no fee will be paid in the event of a hire. Thank you for your understanding.

jd:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated Software Engineering Intern to work closely with experienced senior developers on a next-generation network management service.

As an intern, you’ll contribute to a focused engineering project that may involve systems software, automated testing, performance and scale analysis, or developer tooling.

A key part of the internship will be learning how experienced engineers use AI throughout the software development lifecycle. You’ll use modern AI coding tools to understand existing code, investigate problems, implement changes, troubleshoot failures, generate and improve tests, and analyze results.

Just as importantly, you’ll learn how to question and validate AI-generated work using tests, measurements, code review, and engineering judgment.

What You’ll Work On

Depending on project priorities, your work could include:



- Improving parity and behavioral testing that compares expected behavior across implementations.
- Testing how network management pipeline components work together, from incoming data through processing to stored or displayed results.
- Developing end-to-end test scenarios for realistic user, network, or device workflows.
- Measuring performance and scale and comparing results across configurations or implementations.
- Improving the tools and automation engineers use to build, test, troubleshoot, and validate software changes.
- Using AI to understand unfamiliar areas of the codebase, investigate defects, analyze logs and test failures, and propose potential solutions.
- Participating in code reviews, debugging sessions, and technical discussions with experienced networking software engineers.

Working in an AI-Driven Engineering Process

This internship is about more than using AI to generate code.

You’ll learn how experienced developers integrate AI into their engineering workflow:

Senior developer defines the problem and constraints → Intern works with AI → AI assists with analysis and implementation → Tests and measurements validate the result → Intern reviews the output → Senior developer provides technical guidance

You’ll learn how to provide AI with the right technical context, recognize when its suggestions are incomplete or incorrect, and use objective evidence to determine whether a change actually works.

The goal is to develop both AI fluency and strong engineering judgment.

Mentorship

You’ll work closely with a senior developer who will help:



- Define and scope your project.
- Explain relevant system behavior and architecture.
- Help you navigate an existing codebase.
- Guide your use of AI development tools.
- Review your code, tests, and technical conclusions.
- Help you understand the engineering trade-offs behind different approaches.

You won’t be expected to make product or architecture decisions independently. Instead, you’ll get first-hand experience seeing how experienced engineers approach complex problems and how AI can augment that process.

What We’re Looking For

You may be a good fit if you:



- Are pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Have experience programming and debugging software.
- Understand basic software development concepts such as testing, version control, and code review.
- Have an interest in networking, systems software, or distributed systems.
- Are curious about Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-assisted software engineering.
- Enjoy investigating problems and understanding why something works or fails.
- Can communicate technical reasoning and findings clearly.
- Are comfortable questioning and verifying AI-generated suggestions rather than simply accepting them.

Experience with Rust, Linux, Git, networking, automated testing, containers, or AI coding tools is helpful, but not required.

What You’ll Learn

During the internship, you’ll gain hands-on experience with:



- AI-assisted software engineering.
- Working directly with senior software developers.
- Understanding and modifying a production-scale codebase.
- Network management and systems software.
- Automated and end-to-end testing.
- Performance and scale analysis.
- Debugging and root-cause investigation.
- Using tests and measurements to validate AI-generated software changes.
- Professional code review and engineering practices.

What Success Looks Like

A successful internship will deliver a useful, tested engineering improvement along with a clear explanation of:



- What problem was addressed.
- What changed.
- How AI was used.
- How the result was tested and validated.
- What was learned.
- What limitations or follow-up work remain.

The objective is not simply to generate more code with AI. It is to learn how to use AI effectively and responsibly within a disciplined software engineering process, while developing the technical judgment needed to produce software that engineers can understand, test, and trust.

Stagiaire en développement de logiciel, développement assisté par l’IA (Été 2027)

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en génie logiciel motivé(e) qui travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des développeurs expérimentés sur un service de gestion de réseau de prochaine génération.

Dans le cadre de ce stage, vous contribuerez à un projet d’ingénierie ciblé pouvant toucher au logiciel système, aux tests automatisés, à l’analyse de la performance et de la mise à l’échelle, ou aux outils destinés aux développeurs.

Un aspect important du stage consistera à apprendre comment des développeurs expérimentés utilisent l’intelligence artificielle tout au long du cycle de développement logiciel. Vous utiliserez des outils modernes de développement assisté par l’IA pour comprendre du code existant, analyser des problèmes, apporter des modifications, diagnostiquer des défaillances, générer et améliorer des tests et analyser les résultats.

Tout aussi important, vous apprendrez à remettre en question et à valider le travail généré par l’IA au moyen de tests, de mesures, de revues de code et du jugement d’ingénierie.

Ce sur quoi vous travaillerez

Selon les priorités du projet, vous pourriez notamment :



- Améliorer des tests de parité et de comportement afin de comparer les résultats attendus entre différentes implémentations.
- Tester comment les composants d’une chaîne de traitement de gestion de réseau fonctionnent ensemble, depuis les données d’entrée jusqu’aux résultats stockés ou affichés.
- Développer des scénarios de test de bout en bout reproduisant des flux de travail réalistes impliquant des utilisateurs, des réseaux ou des équipements.
- Mesurer la performance et la capacité de mise à l’échelle, et comparer les résultats entre différentes configurations ou implémentations.
- Améliorer les outils et l’automatisation utilisés par les ingénieurs pour compiler, tester, diagnostiquer et valider les modifications logicielles.
- Utiliser l’IA pour comprendre des parties moins familières du code, analyser des problèmes, examiner des journaux et des échecs de tests, et proposer des solutions.
- Participer à des revues de code, des séances de débogage et des discussions techniques avec des ingénieurs expérimentés en logiciels de réseautique.

Travailler dans un processus d’ingénierie piloté par l’IA

Ce stage va bien au-delà de l’utilisation de l’IA pour simplement générer du code.

Vous apprendrez comment des développeurs expérimentés intègrent l’IA dans leur processus d’ingénierie :

Le développeur expérimenté définit le problème et les contraintes → le stagiaire travaille avec l’IA → l’IA contribue à l’analyse et à l’implémentation → les tests et les mesures valident les résultats → le stagiaire examine les résultats → le développeur fournit des conseils techniques

Vous apprendrez à fournir à l’IA le contexte technique approprié, à reconnaître lorsque ses suggestions sont incomplètes ou incorrectes et à utiliser des données objectives pour déterminer si une modification fonctionne réellement.

L’objectif est de développer à la fois votre maîtrise des outils d’IA et votre jugement d’ingénierie.

Mentorat

Vous travaillerez étroitement avec un développeur expérimenté qui vous aidera à :



- Définir et délimiter votre projet.
- Comprendre le comportement et l’architecture du système.
- Vous familiariser avec une base de code existante.
- Guider votre utilisation des outils de développement assistés par l’IA.
- Réviser votre code, vos tests et vos conclusions techniques.
- Comprendre les compromis techniques associés aux différentes approches.

Vous ne serez pas responsable de prendre seul(e) des décisions concernant le produit ou son architecture. Vous aurez plutôt l’occasion d’observer directement comment des ingénieurs expérimentés abordent des problèmes complexes et comment l’IA peut enrichir ce processus.

Profil recherché

Vous pourriez être un excellent candidat ou une excellente candidate si vous :



- Poursuivez des études en informatique, génie logiciel, génie informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
- Possédez une certaine expérience en programmation et en débogage logiciel.
- Comprenez les principes de base du développement logiciel, notamment les tests, le contrôle de versions et la revue de code.
- Vous intéressez aux réseaux informatiques, aux logiciels systèmes ou aux systèmes distribués.
- Êtes curieux ou curieuse au sujet de l’IA générative, des grands modèles de langage (LLM) et du développement logiciel assisté par l’IA.
- Aimez analyser des problèmes et comprendre pourquoi quelque chose fonctionne ou échoue.
- Êtes capable de communiquer clairement votre raisonnement et vos conclusions techniques.
- Êtes à l’aise de remettre en question et de vérifier les suggestions générées par l’IA plutôt que de simplement les accepter.

Une expérience avec Rust, Linux, Git, les réseaux informatiques, les tests automatisés, les conteneurs ou les outils de développement assistés par l’IA constitue un atout, mais n’est pas obligatoire.

Ce que vous apprendrez

Au cours du stage, vous développerez une expérience pratique dans les domaines suivants :



- Développement logiciel assisté par l’IA.
- Collaboration directe avec des développeurs expérimentés.
- Compréhension et modification d’une base de code à grande échelle.
- Gestion de réseau et logiciels systèmes.
- Tests automatisés et tests de bout en bout.
- Analyse de performance et de mise à l’échelle.
- Débogage et analyse des causes fondamentales.
- Utilisation de tests et de mesures pour valider les modifications logicielles générées avec l’aide de l’IA.
- Revues de code et pratiques professionnelles de génie logiciel.

À quoi ressemble un stage réussi

À La Fin Du Stage, Vous Aurez Livré Une Amélioration Concrète, Utile Et Testée, Accompagnée D’une Explication Claire De



- La problématique abordée.
- Ce qui a été modifié.
- La façon dont l’IA a été utilisée.
- La manière dont les résultats ont été testés et validés.
- Les principaux apprentissages.
- Les limites ou travaux complémentaires qui demeurent.

L’objectif n’est pas simplement de produire davantage de code grâce à l’IA. Il s’agit d’apprendre à utiliser l’IA de manière efficace et responsable dans le cadre d’un processus rigoureux de génie logiciel, tout en développant le jugement technique nécessaire pour produire des logiciels que les ingénieurs peuvent comprendre, tester et auxquels ils peuvent faire confiance.

At Qualcomm, we're committed to engineering human progress by delivering intelligent computing everywhere. We're passionate about harnessing the power of technology to transform industries and improve lives. Our early career programs offer limitless opportunities for growth, mentorship, and meaningful work. By joining our team, you'll be part of a community that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI, computing, and connectivity. With a global footprint spanning over 30 countries, you'll have the chance to collaborate with diverse talent and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology. 

Our early career programs are designed to attract inventive minds, offering a platform to contribute to our long-term innovation pipeline. You'll be part of a community that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Join us for our 2027 intern class in Markham, Canada!

Role Overview

Are you passionate about the future of AI? Imagine a world where connected devices don’t just process information—they understand and instinctively respond to their environment. As part of our team, you’ll contribute to technology that enables generative and cognitive capabilities in everyday devices, from mobile phones and cars to smart home appliances.

Responsibilities may include:

 * Build software tools for profiling and debugging to accelerate the deployment of new neural networks in this rapidly evolving field.
 * Enhance AI system performance to maximize the potential of Qualcomm’s hardware and software platforms.
 * Adapt state-of-the-art neural network models for real-world customer applications on Qualcomm’s hardware and software platforms.
 * Optimize algorithms for machine learning operators and layers within the Qualcomm AI software stack.
 * Maintain, enhance, and develop testing infrastructure and automation to support, validate, and enable AI/ML backend features, ensuring reliability, scalability, and high-quality deployment.

$54,600.00 - $103,350.00

At Manulife John Hancock, we believe in investing in the future – starting with you. Our AI Co-op Program is your launchpad to success, offering the support, structure, and exciting opportunities you need to thrive and make your mark. Our co-op program offers more than just experience; you'll join a vibrant community, participate in engaging events, and benefit from personalized mentorship .       

 As an AI Co-op, you’ll gain hands-on experience applying data science and machine learning techniques to solve real-world business problems. You’ll work with modern tools and datasets to explore and prepare data, develop predictive models, and generate insights that drive decision-making. Join a supportive team and experience a values-first culture where your career development and well-being are prioritized alongside your job impact. You’ll receive guidance from experienced practitioners while gaining exposure to the end-to-end lifecycle of data science, machine learning, and emerging AI solutions in an enterprise environment.    

 We are currently looking for highly motivated students to join us in our Toronto , Ontario , Canada office for a  12 -month co-op , running from January 5 th – December 16 th , 2027 . This is a hybrid position, where you are expected to be in the office Tuesday–Thursday, with the opportunity to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.    

 Position Responsibilities:    

• Explore, prepare, and validate data while ensuring data quality and consistency for analysis and modeling    

• Build and evaluate machine learning models using a range of techniques, with thoughtful experiment design and documentation    

• Support feature engineering, model development, and performance optimization    

• Prototype generative AI solutions (e.g., prompting, retrieval-based methods) with a focus on safety and effectiveness     

• Develop reproducible code and workflows for data processing and modeling using tools such as Python and SQL     

• Communicate insights through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences    

 Required Qualifications:    

• Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field    

• Experience with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java) and familiarity with data manipulation techniques    

• Familiarity with machine learning concepts and tools (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch , or similar frameworks)     

• Experience working with SQL or other data querying languages    

• Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative coding practices     

• Interest in machine learning, data science, and emerging AI technologies    

 Preferred Qualifications:    

• Exposure to machine learning techniques such as regression, tree-based models, neural networks, or time series methods     

• Familiarity with generative AI concepts (e.g., prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation)    

• Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) or data tools (e.g., Databricks, Spark)     

• Exposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and ability to present insights clearly     

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to apply technical solutions to business challenges    

 When you join our team:    

• We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.     

• We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.     

• As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.     

• As part of our co-op program, you will gain early access to Manulife John Hancock’s premier early talent program, GRO, tailored to graduating students! This program is designed to launch your career with the support, structure, and opportunities you need to thrive.    

 Application instructions:      

•  Submit your resume, cover letter, academic transcript, and work term evaluation (if any) in one PDF file .     

  Please note the salary range is expected to be between $54,600 CAD to $72,150 CAD .    

 The actual salary will vary depending on local market conditions, geography, and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. The annual salary will be pro-rated based on the length of the work-term
